elements_selected.content: Implement the section boundary detection algorithm from §4.5. For each file's Vec<MerkleLeaf>, compute the grounding_section for every SplBlock leaf. Algorithm: 1) Walk backwards from the SPL leaf index to find the nearest preceding Heading leaf — this is section_start; if no heading found, section starts at index 0, 2) Walk forward from section_start to find the next Heading at the same or higher level (lower numeric level number) — this is section_end; if not found, section_end = last leaf index, 3) The grounding hash = BLAKE3(concat of hashes of all non-SplBlock leaves in [section_start..=section_end]). If the SPL leaf is in the preamble (no heading above it), grounding context = all content before the first heading (or entire file if no headings). Store the result in SplLeafCached::section_index and in the Section struct. Implement as detect_sections(leaves: &[MerkleLeaf]) -> Vec<Section> and grounding_section(leaves: &[MerkleLeaf], spl_leaf_idx: usize) -> Section in src/merkle.rs. Each Section stores: heading_line, heading_text, heading_level, leaf_range, grounding_hash. Subsection headings (###) create a narrower context than parent sections (##) — this is by design per §4.5.
